subject.title: fix: render workspace avatars in identity card

question: After the SDK leak is repaired, should this PR be the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97602 and should its stricter local-avatar fallback behavior be accepted?
rationale: Automation can remove the accidental public SDK expansion, but choosing this branch over overlapping avatar PRs and accepting the compatibility behavior needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Repair and use this PR
options.body: Keep the owner-level projection, remove the public SDK expansion, and land this branch as the canonical fix if the local-avatar policy is acceptable.

options.title: Preserve older compatibility
options.body: Require a narrower change that fixes identity/bootstrap without changing existing list or fallback behavior beyond the reported broken route.

options.title: Defer to a narrower PR
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers prefer one of the smaller overlapping avatar PRs as the landing vehicle.

recommendation.title: Repair and use this PR
recommendation.body: Keep the owner-level projection, remove the public SDK expansion, and land this branch as the canonical fix if the local-avatar policy is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest combined history across avatar hardening and Plugin SDK boundary work.
